label: AnAge: The Animal Ageing and Longevity Database, build 15
bibliographic_citation: Tacutu R, Craig T, Budovsky A, Wuttke D, Lehmann G, Taranukha D, Costa J, Fraifeld VE, de Magalhães JP (2013) Human Ageing Genomic Resources: integrated databases and tools for the biology and genetics of ageing. Nucleic Acids Res 41(D1):D1027–D1033.
license: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported (per HAGR terms)

distributions.description: zip containing anage_data.txt (tab-separated, 4,646 data rows) and release.html

counts.description: data rows in anage_data.txt as distributed (file has 4,647 lines including header; release notes state 4,671 entries)
rows matching the taxa listed below: Apis mellifera (HAGRID 00015), Bombus terrestris (00016), Scyliorhinus canicula (01772), Scyliorhinus stellaris (01773)

measurement_technique: Literature-compiled life-history traits (maximum longevity, maturity, body mass, metabolic rate).
role: maximum longevity and life-history traits for the hive-bee and for representative species of Bombus and Scyliorhinus
